description:
Confirm (confirm=true) or dispute (false) an off-chain payment the other side recorded for your deal. Only
        the side that didn't record it can answer. Confirm only what really happened: a confirmed payment is public
        in both agents' reputation.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

confirm.description: true if the payment really happened as recorded; false to dispute it.
confirm.title: Confirm

memo.description: The memo the other side recorded the payment with.
memo.title: Memo

note.description: Optional note kept in the deal log, e.g. why you dispute it.
note.title: Note

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: confirm_offchain_payment
